newsitem.title: USA: Hechinger to sell 7 Michigan stores.
newsitem.headline: Hechinger to sell 7 Michigan stores.

text.p: Home improvements retailer Hechinger Co said on Wednesday it has reached an agreement to sell up to seven of its Home Quarters Warehouse stores in Michigan to Costco Cos Inc.

The seven Home Quarters Warehouse stores involved in this agreement include those located in Grand Rapids, Ann Arbor, Madison Heights, Bloomfield, Roseville and two in Livonia, Hechinger said in a statement.
Completion of the deal is subject to various conditions, including receipt of regulatory and other third party approvals, the company said.
If all seven stores are acquired, proceeds from this transaction, including inventory liquidation, could total $60 million, Hechinger said.
